# truenas_nvmet_subsys (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS NVMe-oF subsystem by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) NVMe-oF subsystem name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allow_any_host` (Boolean) Allow any host to connect to this subsystem without an explicit host mapping.
- `ana` (Boolean) Whether Asymmetric Namespace Access (ANA) is enabled for this subsystem.
- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF subsystem ID.
- `ieee_oui` (String) IEEE Organizationally Unique Identifier used when generating namespace identifiers.
- `pi_enable` (Boolean) Whether end-to-end data protection (PI) is enabled for this subsystem.
- `qid_max` (Number) Maximum number of queues supported by this subsystem.
- `serial` (String) Serial number assigned by TrueNAS.
- `subnqn` (String) NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) for the subsystem.
